name: aggrega-vscode-extension
description: Language support for Aggrega YAML — validation, navigation, hover, completion via the aggrega daemon.

aggrega.server.binaryPath.description: Path to the aggrega binary. Plain name resolves via PATH; absolute or relative paths are honored as written.

aggrega.server.autoRevalidate.description: When true, silently revalidates a file on cache-miss and retries the request. When false, surfaces a notification with a Revalidate action.

aggrega.server.debounceMs.description: Debounce window in milliseconds for proactive validate-on-change.

aggrega.server.respawnAttempts.description: Maximum daemon respawn attempts within the sliding window before the extension surfaces a stopped-responding notification.

aggrega.server.respawnWindowSeconds.description: Sliding window in seconds for counting daemon respawn attempts.
